dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual symmetrical narrowing of the body mass from the lower-mid frame toward the top of the frame, forming a rounded parabolic point.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins appear smooth with no visible bulges; however, pixel-level resolution at the water interface is low due to noise.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey to off-white, though heavily influenced by sensor noise and a chromatic purple-tinted lighting condition.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density, diffuse dark-grey patches visible on the upper dorsal surface and along the left-side lateral margin.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; transition between the grey mottling and the lighter skin areas lacks sharp edges.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: One small, distinct dark circular mark located on the central dorsal axis near the tapering top of the frame. Visible longitudinal linear streaks on the lower-right dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint, parallel longitudinal linear marks (potential rake marks) are visible on the lower right-hand side of the dorsal plane.
